caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher with a handle and a spout, positioned upright against a plain, pale beige or off-white background. The pitcher is primarily a light grayish-blue color, and it is decorated with stylized floral or botanical patterns in a darker blue. The decorative motifs appear in two horizontal bands: one near the top edge of the pitcher and one broader band in the middle of the body. The handle of the pitcher is attached at the upper part and curves outward and downward. The pitcher has a rounded body that tapers slightly towards the base and a flared rim at the top. The surface of the ceramic is depicted with smooth shading to suggest its glossy texture. There is a small, discrete signature in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
